BY FIRST COMPLAINT: 77 SILENT (output differs, rc 0, nothing on stderr); 19 statement dropped; 13 TIMEOUT at 60 s (perl < 8 s: look for #2098's quadratic shapes and BigInt speed); 11 regex code block `(?{...})` stripped (ruled non-support); 10 undefined sub (POSIX floor/ceil = #1997, Digest::SHA = XS); 18 rc 1/255 with no recognizable message; 3 binding-stack exhausted (#1929); Storable / Unicode::Normalize / Encode missing (XS); 2 refused; 26 distinct messages in all.
CAUSES ALREADY SEEN in the first 27 (do not re-derive): regex `\K` silently never matches (`s/.{71}\K /\n/gr`; cf. #2050, #1528); a `#!/usr/bin/perl -l` SHEBANG switch is ignored (#2097); `for <10 3>` glob-as-word-list dropped; Math::BigInt (`ack2(4,2) has 3 digits` where perl has 19,729).
METHOD (the op/ census rounds' rules apply): a COUNT is not a finding -- re-run each failure for its CAUSE; group by cause, ONE task per cause with the smallest reproducer probed vs perl; grep the task store, DECIDED and not-supported.md before filing (expect about a third to be known); the round's output is a cause table `program -> cause -> task`, checked in with the corpus subset that becomes part of the everyday instrument (#2099: programs are third-party text -- check Rosetta's licence (GFDL 1.2) before checking any in; otherwise keep the fetch + select scripts and the expectations only).
Bar for calling the round done: every one of the 77 silent programs has a cause; the loud ones at least a class.

The 105 by first complaint (classify.pl, classes.tsv): 43 SILENT, 28 loud (5 `try` / `e` / `INFINITY` not exported by bigint / bignum / POSIX, 2 List::Util max / min undefined, 3 raw Lisp conditions), 12 announced not-supported (11 regex code blocks, 1 bigrat), 11 dropped / refused (2 given / when, 2 a Unicode variable name), 4 Unicode::Normalize (XS), 3 other output with a PCL notice, 2 timeouts (Cycle-detection, Power-set), 2 heap / binding stack.  18 are outside the subset, 87 are ours.
THE PLAN = docs/rosetta-plan.md: step 0 merge the running batches and re-run; step 1 the census, two agents (A the silent programs, B the rest), one task per CAUSE with `frequency: ordinary` and the program as evidence, the cause table baselines/rosetta-causes.tsv; step 2 the instrument (a recipe, the baseline, a history file); step 3 fix batches ranked by programs broken; step 5 ONE run of a fresh sample (proposed: Perl Weekly Challenge solutions; the USER to confirm).  This task is the census's owner; `triage` stays tooling (a measurement), its finds are IN.

=== s543o (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-27): STEP 2 OF THE PLAN DONE -- THE INSTRUMENT ===  `tools/rosetta-corpus` (build / verify / run / classify / manifest; rules in tools/lib/PCLRosetta.pm) rebuilds the corpus from the pinned commit 1d475861d7141ef2fafff293d9339f56e4b0f5db and checks it against baselines/rosetta-corpus.tsv (names + sha256 only); its place is PCLPaths::rosetta_dir ($PCL_ROSETTA_DIR, else ~/.pcl-cache/rosetta -- populated on this box with s543o's verified build).  `tools/rosetta-corpus run` = the ONE way to run it: `ROSETTA: N of 650 identical to perl (P %) -- <sha> gen <gen>` with baselines/rosetta-causes.tsv as the baseline (NEW / FIXED / MOVED / UNEXPLAINED / STALE) and baselines/rosetta-history.tsv (`--record`). Census agents: agent A's silent set is 42 (1442 is gone); `tools/rosetta-corpus classify --outdir OUT` gives each differing program's class and names a row whose class moved.
